chunks: Other than Him who created me. He will show me the right way.

key_terms.فَطَرَنِي: Created me (from fitrah, implying original nature/creation)

ai.seo_question: Who guides humanity to the right path according to this Quranic verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the intrinsic link between creation (khalq) and guidance (hidayah), affirming that God’s creative act inherently includes the provision for spiritual direction. It serves as a foundational proof for the necessity of divine guidance, whether through prophets or the Imams, ensuring that the created being is not left to wander without a source of truth.
